subject: general
question: Which of the following animal statues is depicted at the top of the Ashoka pillar of Rampurva?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bull.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bull **statue is depicted at the top of the **Ashoka pillar of Rampurva.**
 
• These are a pair of Ashoka's pillars located in the** Champaran district of Bihar.**
 
• The bull capital is located at the center of the entrance of the** Rashtrapathi Bhavan.**
 
• Inscriptions of Ashoka were inscribed on the Pillars of Ashoka which are located in** Rampurva (Champaran), Meerut, Kausambi (now Allahabad pillar), Lauria Nandangarh, Chopra Kalan, and in other parts of the country.**
 
• There are **seven pillar edicts and 14 rock edicts** of the Indian emperor Ashoka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lauria Nandangarh **

 
 
• It is a pillar located in the **Champaran district of Bihar.**
 
• It is situated near the **Burhi Gandak River. **
 
• The height of the sandstone structure pillar is** 32 feet.**
 
• The **statue of the lion** is placed on the abacus of the pillar.
 
 
 
• **Saranath pillar **
 
 
• It is located in **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• This pillar is made up of **Chunar Sandstone** and its base is a long shaft made of **monolithic rock.**
 
• On top of the abacus was an** animal figure.**
 
• The Abacus and animal part of the Sarnath pillar forms the** national emblem of India.**
 
• In the abacus, four animals are shown. They are** a bull, an elephant, a galloping horse, and a lion.**
 
• The Lion symbolizes the Buddha spreading Dhamma in all directions. It was built in commemoration of** the first sermon by Buddha** or **Dhammachakraparivartana.**
